documents.text: Faster HDT-SMP v4.1.1 legacy MCM installer can retain the same-named ESP stub when the old plugin is active or inactive. Source rules do not verify saves.
Faster HDT-SMP v4.0.0 and v4.0.1 installer source lists no old MCM ESP copy rule. These revision identities remain distinct from v4.1.1.
Faster HDT-SMP installation selects one CPU option: No AVX, AVX, AVX2 or AVX512. No performance rank or hardware support was measured.
Windows directory observation logical pathname bytes counts each observed filename. Two hardlink names can refer to the same unique file.
Windows observed identified allocation counts stable native file identity once. It is not reclaimable or free space.
Windows comparison withholds numeric differences for partial reports, including entry caps and missing stable IDs.
In Survivor Arena Rift Expedition, the main world and clock pause during an independent side run. An exported tape can restore inside the rift and return to the same main time.
Camp Expedition run tape keeps earned crystal and purchased health totem rank and spent resources. There is no shared or account-wide wallet.
A Nexus file ID identifies an exact archive independently of the Nexus project ID. Do not substitute the latest archive when checking an existing file.
Modrinth version dependency edges identify a concrete version or a project, which are scoped differently; release names are not file or version identifiers.
EmbeddingGemma 2 precision prefers bfloat16 where supported or float32. Publisher documentation says float16 is incompatible.
EmbeddingGemma 2 supports 128 256 512 and 768 dimensions. Queries and document embeddings must agree, with normalization after truncation.
EmbeddingGemma 2 selectively loads vision and audio encoders. Text, image, audio and video search can share its embedding space.
Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B supports text, images and video. The model card does not establish standalone audio embeddings.
